# alert-rule-lint

> Lint Prometheus alerting rule files for structure and team policy: required labels and annotations, severity values, durations, unknown keys and naming Python package `trysac-alert-rule-lint`, import name `alert_rule_lint`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
